reasons: Status is correctly 'missing': the cited General Provisions run from Governing Law through Representation by Counsel (k) straight to the signature block, and the only 'insurance' reference is a pass-through cost clause, so no insurance covenant exists anywhere.

The redline is actionable and minimal: it appends a new subsection (l) INSURANCE immediately after the last lettered general provision (k) and before the signature block, preserving the existing lettering sequence and leaving all other text untouched.

Inserted language tracks the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Licensor processes our data, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request) and is properly conformed to the agreement's Licensor/Licensee terminology and the term-plus-one-year duration.
Comment is concise, first person plural, states what changed and why, cites the playbook limits and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback, consistent with the required tone and prefix.

Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and an insurance obligation is present in the result; the minor use of the undefined phrase 'Licensee data' rather than a defined term does not undermine the edit.
